Appendix A. Resource Assessment Radius Maps and State Data The resource assessment was conducted at a 50- and 100-mile radii for each airport (Figures A-1 and A-2). For some airports, this included feedstocks from New York counties since they fell within that radius. Table A-1 lists all counties that was within the 50- and 100-mile radii of the airports. Table A-2 shows total resources by type for each New England state plus the select New York counties. Reminder that these numbers differ from those shown in the report for airports as their radii extend into multiple states and in some instances overlap.
